description: Unplanned Road Closures (Historical Data) is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by ACT Government Open Data. This data set is a record of unplanned road closures within the ACT. This data contains all information recorded since the implementation of an ESRI Survey 123 solution to handle Temporary Traffic Management (TTM) Applications. Coverage: ACT Government Open Data. The portal files it under the publisher ACT Government Open Data. Its tags are closure, roads, traffic, transport, ttm. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, JSON, KML, KMZ. The portal shows 2026-09-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is other licence as labelled on the portal (terms not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
